# Dentist OS
> Complete dental clinic operating system: WhatsApp patient communication, visual tooth-charting, milestone fee collection, automated recalls, lab tracking, branded clinic website included. Built by Beyond Pixells, a product studio in India that
> builds sector-specific operating systems for local businesses. Working demo clinic live.

## Facts
- India-native: WhatsApp-first automation, UPI payments, flat INR pricing
- No per-member fees; one-time setup + flat monthly subscription
- Every rollout includes a branded website, member/patient portal and owner dashboard
